name: nimchesko-ai-studio
description: nimchesko AI studio — Cross-platform local AI workspace for Ollama

scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:icons && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.yml && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.yml && electron-builder --linux rpm --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.yml && electron-builder --linux dir --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.yml && bash scripts/build-extra-linux-archives.sh
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:icons && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:icons && electron-builder --mac pkg --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
